messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was in better bike shape last year, and had more ski-time on my legs.

output.original_text: I was in better bike shape last year, and had more ski-time on my legs.
output.joy: I felt so fit on the bike last year, and I enjoyed so much ski-time on my legs!
output.sadness: I miss the bike shape I had last year, and I long for the ski-time I once enjoyed on my legs.
output.fear: I hope I can get back to the bike shape I had last year, and I'm worried about losing ski-time on my legs.
output.anger: I can’t believe how out of bike shape I got since last year, and it’s frustrating to think I had less ski-time on my legs now!
output.surprise: I can't believe how much better I was in bike shape last year, and I surprised myself with all that ski-time on my legs!
output.disgust: It's disgusting how I let my bike shape slip since last year, and I can’t stand that I’ve had so little ski-time on my legs.
